module: Module 4: Order Execution, Modification & Bulk Routing
title: Order Expiration (Good 'Til Cancelled vs Day Order)
precondition: Master sets Day Order with expiration at 17:00 NY close.
expected_result: All child limit orders expire and cancel cleanly in unison; zero stuck pending orders.
actual_result: Time-In-Force (GTC, DAY) expiration handles automated cancellation of unfilled child orders at session close.
